messages.subject: failed to create directory: file exists
parts:
Hello,
 I am having another problem. After changing some parameters (including "E"), the model ran! However, now I am trying to compare different models. I have given the models different names. I get the following error:


*** ERROR ***   fail to create directory [C:/DOCUME~1/christym/LOCALS~1/Temp/Rtmpk0n5TI/file338c59dc/results.files/fixed.effect]: File exists

result1=inla(formula,family="nbinomial",data=habitat3,E=3,control.inla=list(h=0.01),verbose=FALSE,control.predictor=list(compute=T))   # this works

result3=inla(formula3,family="nbinomial",data=habitat3,E=3,control.inla=list(h=0.01),verbose=FALSE,control.predictor=list(compute=T))     # this gives error

Is this a problem with how the temporary files are being stored?

Thanks again for any suggestions!

Christy
